steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. I compared the two listings and they match on every detail that matters.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

The product is the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 in graphite, and it's identical in both listings.

The two listings even show the same rating and review count. That may mean the reviews belong to the product and not to the seller. If so, the rating tells you nothing about how reliable either seller is.

To choose between them, you could:
- **Check the seller's own reputation.** Look for independent reviews of Ottervale Audio and Brackmoor Sound elsewhere.
- **Look for hidden differences at checkout.** Taxes, delivery estimates for your address, or payment options might differ.
- **Check for authorization.** See whether either seller is an authorized Quellwyn retailer. That can affect how smoothly a warranty claim goes.

If none of those turns up a difference, pick either one. Nothing on the listing pages favors one over the other.
